method: Native factory-only renders of two named Apple preview excerpts per genre, measured with BS.1770 integrated loudness and true peak. Input targets reserve reference peak headroom. Curves retain their genre contour while reducing measured extremes; final drive is bounded by measured limiting and dynamic contrast. These are playback choices, not official genre EQ standards or full-track loudness measurements.
